title: David Stevens, A Critical Vulnerability (2005), Papers in Australian Maritime Affairs No.15

locators.patrols: Appendix V, printed pp.353–356; PDF indices369–372

inspection: Patrol tables and shipping figures visually checked with PDF screenshots. Day totals are reported patrol length, NOT verified on-station time.
limitations: Appendix is a reconstructed record, not a complete observation/launch log.
Dureenbee is a total loss after damage/abandonment, not necessarily an immediate torpedo sinking.
Some tonnages/dates/methods differ from Gill; variants are preserved.

title: G. Hermon Gill, Royal Australian Navy 1942–1945 (1968), Chapter 3
kind: Australian official history using wartime records and postwar accounts
limitations: Guatemala 5,967 tons here versus5,527 in S1; no resolved aggregate GRT adopted.
Early boat attribution for Iron Crown is tentative; later S1 I-27 attribution retained with caveat.
Indian Ocean 16 ships /76,123 tons is a mixed submarine-and-surface-raider aggregate, not submarine-only.

title: G. Hermon Gill, Royal Australian Navy 1942–1945 (1968), Chapter 7
limitations: 14 June submarine sinkings plus5 early-July victims is a source-reported aggregate; ship list and patrol-day denominator still required.
The26-DD distribution is a period snapshot, not a constant allocation throughout1942.

title: US Naval Technical Mission to Japan, O-32, Japanese Torpedo Fire Control

locators.Type92: printed pp.12–13; scanned report visual inspection

limitations: Describes apparatus, not representative1942 combat success probabilities.
Common observed target-motion errors must not be counted as independent errors for every torpedo.

title: US Naval Technical Mission to Japan, S-42, Japanese Navy Diesel Engines
limitations: Confirms cooling/spares/manufacturing/training problems, not a fleet-wide failure denominator.
Do not adopt the questionable submerged-speed sentence on the same page as a submarine performance specification.
Figures for other diesel models and later war production cannot be transplanted to1942 large I-boats.

title: Tanaka Hiromi, The Japanese Navy’s operations against Australia (AWM journal,1997)
limitations: Narrative six-merchant-vessel figure has unclear scope relative to verified coast/time subsets.
Reports torpedo trouble without a launch denominator. Do not estimate absolute failure rate from that sentence.

title: Royal Australian Navy, Anti-submarine warfare, mine warfare and coastal trade
limitations: Overview corroboration only, not a quantitative conversion-rate dataset.
